subject: An English-Hebrew code-switching fine-tune of Parakeet
preheader: On-device dictation that writes the Hebrew words English speakers in Israel use.
paragraphs: I'm Daniel, an English speaker in Jerusalem. I've been fine-tuning Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 so it gets the Hebrew words we Anglos mix into English, like kupat holim, written properly.
It runs on your phone or computer in the free Hebrish app, and the models and data are all open: [hebrish.app](https://hebrish.app).
Thought it might be up your street. No pressure at all, but I'd be happy to hear what you think.
